purpose: Reproduce the native Help preconditions from the pre-feature source, independently of Help delivery, native ladder controller, and the feature trace. No candidate trace is an oracle input.

native_sources.rule: One normal-state update or Attack update per full update.
ResetValues clears rogue value but preserves timer; SpawnBot enters Buy.
Rogue interval and chance are redrawn only after retained timer elapsed.
Leave Buy outside the public buy-zone signal before buying policies.
Compute native path including ladders; adapter must discover public ladder topology for cross-area objectives.
